sequential_dependency.intermediate: The complete input-dependent sized background grid before foreground overlay.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Count the two upper masks and construct the lower-left background field at the resulting output dimensions using the episode background mode.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Repeat the lower-right foreground tile across that canvas, writing nonzero pixels and retaining the intermediate field at transparent zeros.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Transparent foreground positions consume values from the sized background. Replacing its interpolation changes final pixels even while output dimensions and the foreground tile remain fixed.
